about_the_game:
BLIND_SITE is a first-person horror game focused on photography mechanics. Players explore dark environments using their camera's flash to navigate and uncover secrets. The flash system serves as both a vital tool and a risk, as it attracts a fast-moving hostile entity that responds to light. The same goes sound, as each thing you do has a ripple effect throughout the facility.

Features:

  • Use photography mechanics to progress

  • Manage enemy attention triggered by camera and realistic noise system

  • Avoid multiple hostile entities with unique behaviors

  • Weird story with a couple endings
